fitReason: New-2025 teaching-track faculty member with a documented current master’s advisee and a physically demonstrated language-to-navigation project. This is an applied robotics/HRI backup with narrower methodological evidence than a robot-learning research lab; the exact teaching title and Seattle location are preserved.

physicalEvidence.summary: The current advisee’s 2026 master’s project documents Whisper transcription, Claude tool-use and Piper speech driving a real Unitree Go1 through ROS 2/Nav2. The project page shows named-waypoint runs; its full public README reports an end-to-end voice pipeline and navigation in two labs. Human approval gates navigation plans, while low-level locomotion/navigation are conventional components rather than newly trained policies. This is a student-built prototype without a peer-reviewed benchmark or reported trial denominator. Current advising is independently stated on the student’s homepage.

unknowns: The appointment is Assistant Teaching Professor, not a tenure-track research Assistant Professor. Research-visitor sponsorship authority, project time, hardware availability, funding, duration and summer 2027 capacity need separate confirmation.

Northeastern Seattle is the proposed host. Former University of Washington RAVEN surgical work and the stated UW affiliate role do not establish Northeastern hardware ownership or access to UW facilities.

The current prototype uses pretrained language/speech models and classical navigation. No autonomous surgery, clinical validation or general-purpose learned locomotion claim is made. The older neural instrument-segmentation study is image analysis, not itself executed control.

The previously verified Northeastern Visiting Student process includes external master’s students with faculty sponsorship, but requires a majority of support from non-personal/non-family sources. Fully personal funding is not supported by that published route; boundary wording and Seattle appointment applicability must be confirmed.

Reused institutional guidance asks at least four months’ initiation, with the engineering process estimating five to seven months. Published support figures and all 2027 fees/insurance require rechecking; a university process is not a lab invitation.
Public robot research does not confirm current equipment access, a summer 2027 offer or host availability.

Official current appointment began in August 2025 as Assistant Teaching Professor at Seattle; the current master’s advising link does not independently establish authority to sponsor outside research visitors.
